info.biography: 诸葛亮，字孔明，号卧龙居士，琅琊阳都人。刘备曾“三顾茅庐”得见卧龙。卧龙以一篇《隆中对》分析天下形势，提出先取荆州，再取益州成鼎足之势的说法。庞统，字士元，襄阳[治今湖北襄阳]人。三国时刘备帐下谋士，官拜军师中郎将。才智与诸葛亮齐名，人称“凤雏”。
info.characteristic: 需要特别注意回合内爆发及回合外防御之间的平衡

nameSemanticsEvidence.assessment: Official platform player observation describes elemental Slash outputs separately. Its reply only acknowledges feedback, not an official ruling. This module retains exact effective CardKind per once-used output instead of importing unrelated name normalization.

implementationNotes: Every face is limited once per actual Round; extra turns do not reset either face. The initial face is Yang.
Only actual Use is allowed: native Dodge/Nullification/dying recovery uses are supported; plain Response-only Slash or Dodge is not.

A paid native slot abolition owns its original frozen use target/source invoice. Its actual cost movement/recovery children complete before the native zero-material use; a paid cost is not repeated after replay or skill loss.
Post-abolition Slash distance and use-count checks exclude every entity of the selected native equipment category.

Luanfeng observes the actual DyingEntering window and checks maximum HP locally, restores all native abolished slots after recovery children, and draws up to 6 minus the number truly restored. Self rescue clears only lifetime used output kinds, not the current face or either Round quota.
Whole-area legacy abolition restores five distinct categories and therefore draws up to one hand card.

A formerly paid rescue whose native equipment-removal recovery already saves its dying victim finishes that original Dying without issuing a no-longer-needed card. Its real cost and face quota remain paid, and an unissued output never enters the lifetime used-kind ledger.
Exact paid sources remain eligible for their frozen needed native use after skill loss, without reopening unowned conversion choices outside that one unconsumed paid invoice.
Private original response-menu integrity proofs stay in trusted internal event fields with JsonIgnore and safe text projection; public event members do not expose the private menu or its digest.
